# Jean-Zey

> Mumbai's premium fashion brand offering jeans, shirts, t-shirts and combos for men and women.

## About
Jean-Zey is a luxury fashion brand based in Mumbai, India. We deliver premium clothing directly to customers across Mumbai with free shipping, open box delivery, and a personal touch on every order.

## Products
- Men's and Women's Jeans
- Shirts (formal and casual)
- T-Shirts
- Combo outfits
- Bags
- Perfumes

## Key Information
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Delivery: Free delivery exclusively across Mumbai
- Payment: Cash, UPI, or Digital payment at delivery (COD)
- Open Box Delivery: Orders unsealed in customer's presence
- Contact: +91-9987683105
